name: When is the final deposit usually due for a pre-construction property?

mainEntity.name: When is the final deposit usually due for a pre-construction property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The final deposit for a pre-construction property is typically due either shortly before closing or at the time of closing. This payment usually brings the total deposit amount to the agreed-upon percentage of the purchase price, with the remaining balance covered by your mortgage. This is a critical timing aspect to coordinate with your lender and agent to ensure a smooth transition to ownership, especially in competitive markets like Miami-Dade and Broward County.
acceptedAnswer.description: The final pre-construction deposit is generally due near or at the time of closing the property.
